// AutoFlushOptions
interface AutoFlushOptions {
    owner?: string;
    lock?: SenderLock;
    backoffMs?: number[];
    target?: EventTarget & {
        document?: {
            visibilityState?: string;
        };
    };
    isOnline?: () => boolean;
    onReport?: (report: FlushReport | "skipped") => void;
    onError?: (err: unknown) => void;
}

// AutoFlusher
interface AutoFlusher {
    kick(): void;
    stop(): void;
}

// BackgroundSupport
type BackgroundSupport = "background" | "open_app";

// BackgroundSyncOptions
interface BackgroundSyncOptions {
    tag?: string;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    serviceWorker?: ServiceWorkerContainerLike | null;
}

// CreateWebStoreOptions
interface CreateWebStoreOptions extends IndexedDbStoreOptions {
    onFallback?: (reason: unknown) => void;
}

// IndexedDbStore
class IndexedDbStore<P = unknown> implements Store<P> {
    constructor(options?: IndexedDbStoreOptions);
    read(): Promise<OutboxItem<P>[]>;
    update<T>(fn: (items: OutboxItem<P>[]) => T): Promise<T>;
    isDurable(): Promise<boolean>;
    close(): void;
}

// IndexedDbStoreOptions
interface IndexedDbStoreOptions {
    name?: string;
    indexedDB?: IDBFactory;
}

// LeaseStorage
interface LeaseStorage {
    getItem(key: string): string | null;
    setItem(key: string, value: string): void;
    removeItem(key: string): void;
}

// LockedRun
type LockedRun<T> = {
    ran: true;
    via: "web-lock" | "lease" | "alone";
    value: T;
} | {
    ran: false;
};

// OnBackgroundSyncOptions
interface OnBackgroundSyncOptions {
    tag?: string;
}

// SenderLock
class SenderLock {
    readonly holderId: string;
    constructor(options?: SenderLockOptions);
    run<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<LockedRun<T>>;
}

// SenderLockOptions
interface SenderLockOptions {
    name?: string;
    webLocks?: WebLockApi | null;
    leaseStorage?: LeaseStorage | null;
    leaseMs?: number;
    refreshMs?: number;
    confirmDelayMs?: number;
    now?: () => number;
    wait?: (ms: number) => Promise<void>;
}

// ServiceWorkerContainerLike
interface ServiceWorkerContainerLike {
    ready: Promise<unknown>;
}

// SyncEventLike
interface SyncEventLike {
    tag: string;
    waitUntil(promise: Promise<unknown>): void;
}

// WebLockApi
interface WebLockApi {
    request<R>(name: string, options: {
        ifAvailable: boolean;
    }, callback: (lock: unknown) => Promise<R>): Promise<R>;
}

// createWebStore
function createWebStore<P = unknown>(options?: CreateWebStoreOptions): Promise<Store<P>>;

// onBackgroundSync
function onBackgroundSync(event: SyncEventLike | Event, flush: () => Promise<unknown>, options?: OnBackgroundSyncOptions): boolean;

// requestBackgroundSync
function requestBackgroundSync(options?: BackgroundSyncOptions): Promise<BackgroundSupport>;

// requestPersistentStorage
function requestPersistentStorage(): Promise<boolean>;

// startAutoFlush
function startAutoFlush<P>(outbox: Outbox<P>, options?: AutoFlushOptions): AutoFlusher;
